title: Rosarin alleviates dry eye disease via suppressing NF-kappaB signal mediated inflammation and M1 polarization in macrophage.
authors: Chen, Lihua; Wei, Xueping; Zhang, Zhuo; Lu, Yuxin; Huang, Long Shuang; Zhang, Haijiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Rosarin通过抑制NF-kappaB信号减轻干眼症炎症，仅涉及分子对接作为辅助手段，核心是湿实验与疾病机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Local chronic inflammation is critical to the pathogenesis of dry eye disease (DED). Rosarin is a natural bioactive compound isolated from Rhodiola rosea L., which has shown significant antioxidant and neuroprotective properties in various preclinical researches. However, its role and mechanism of action in DED remains unclear. Thus, we aimed to investigate the protective role of Rosarin in a preclinical mouse model of DED, and to address the molecular mechanism of Rosarin in the regulation of inflammation and polarization in macrophages. The results showed that treatment using Rosarin increased tear production, mitigated corneal and conjunctival tissue disruption, suppressed phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha and NF-kappaB, and inhibited the expression of downstream inflammatory and macrophage M1 polarization marker genes (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha), CD86 and iNOS in Benzalkonium Chloride (BAC)-induced DED mice. By using network pharmacology screening, molecular docking and in vitro molecular biology studies we determined that Rosarin inhibited macrophage M1 polarization and inflammatory response by inhibiting NF-kappaB signals. In conclusion, Rosarin treatment alleviates BAC-induced DED in mice by inhibiting NF-kappaB mediated inflammation and M1 polarization in macrophages. Our findings not only provide a theoretical foundation for the clinical application of Rosarin but also open new avenues for targeted therapy of DED.
abstract_zh: 局部慢性炎症对于干眼病（DED）的发病机制至关重要。Rosarin是一种从红景天（Rhodiola rosea L.）中分离出的天然生物活性化合物，在多种临床前研究中显示出显著的抗氧化和神经保护特性。然而，其在DED中的作用及作用机制尚不清楚。因此，我们旨在研究Rosarin在临床前小鼠DED模型中的保护作用，并探讨Rosarin在调节巨噬细胞炎症和极化中的分子机制。结果表明，使用Rosarin治疗增加了泪液分泌，减轻了角膜和结膜组织损伤，抑制了IkappaBalpha和NF-kappaB的磷酸化，并抑制了苯扎氯铵（BAC）诱导的DED小鼠中下游炎症及巨噬细胞M1极化标志基因（IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha）、CD86和iNOS的表达。通过网络药理学筛选、分子对接和体外分子生物学研究，我们确定Rosarin通过抑制NF-kappaB信号来抑制巨噬细胞M1极化和炎症反应。总之，Rosarin治疗通过抑制NF-kappaB介导的炎症和巨噬细胞M1极化，减轻了BAC诱导的小鼠DED。我们的发现不仅为Rosarin的临床应用提供了理论基础，也为DED的靶向治疗开辟了新途径。
